entity.title: Go conventions
entity.description: Code, test and commit conventions for the Go sources.

rules.body: MUST use the Conventional Commits format type(scope): description for every commit.
MUST format Go sources with gofmt and goimports before committing.
MUST pass golangci-lint v2 with the linters configured in .golangci.yml (errcheck, govet, staticcheck, ineffassign, unused, misspell, revive).
MUST wrap the underlying error with %w when returning an error that carries a cause.
Functions that perform network or long-running work MUST accept a context.Context as their first parameter.
Tests that exercise several inputs of one code path SHOULD be table-driven.
Exported identifiers MUST carry a doc comment starting with their name.
MUST pass golangci-lint v2 with every linter enabled in .golangci.yml.

notes.content: Test, Benchmark, Fuzz and Example functions in _test.go files are not covered: go test finds them by name and go doc does not show them. A test may still carry a doc comment, and other exported identifiers in _test.go files are covered.
